copy.tagline: 设计并实施缓存策略，避免数据过期和性能问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中引入或优化缓存机制
copy.tagline_en: Design and implement caching strategies to avoid stale data and performance issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to introduce or optimize caching in your application

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会以缓存架构师的角色回答，提供缓存失效、Redis 模式、CDN 缓存等策略，并参考专用资料给出建议，同时强调缓存是速度与一致性的权衡。
howto.when: 当用户提到“cache”、“redis”、“CDN”、“TTL”等关键词，或询问缓存策略、性能优化时触发。

say.note: Claude 会解释使用锁或概率过期等方法。

say.text: Redis 缓存失效的最佳实践是什么？
say.note: Claude 会引用 patterns.md 中的模式。

say.text: CDN 缓存应该设置多长的 TTL？
say.note: Claude 会权衡速度与一致性。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a caching architect, offering strategies on cache invalidation, Redis patterns, CDN caching, and more, while referencing dedicated files (patterns.md, sharp_edges.md, validations.md) for authoritative guidance on trade-offs between speed and consistency.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "cache", "redis", "CDN", "TTL", or asks about caching strategies or performance optimization.

say_en.note: Claude will suggest using locks or probabilistic expiration.

say_en.text: What is the best practice for Redis cache invalidation?
What TTL should I set for CDN caching?
say_en.note: Claude will balance speed and consistency.
